# Character scope. A court official's score with a fixed lean <l> (issue and office: oe_tsn_official_score_l<l>).
oe_tsn_official_score_l5 = {
    value = 55
    add = 5
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { has_variable = oe_m9_favour } } add = 5 }
    if = { limit = { is_loyal = no } add = -30 }
    if = { limit = { has_estate = estate_type:crown_estate } add = 10 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate >= 0.6 } } add = 10 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate < 0.3 } } add = -15 }
    else_if = { limit = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate has_global_variable = oe_phoenix_empire exists = global_var:oe_phoenix_empire global_var:oe_phoenix_empire = { estate_satisfaction:clergy_estate >= 0.6 } } add = 10 }
